usedFor: Teams use Anakin.io to pull web data with “Scrape URL”, “Start Website Crawl” and “Create Website Monitor”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Website Monitor” in Anakin.io
bestTemplate.why: A monitor keeps watching a website for you, so nobody has to scrape the page by hand.

watchOut: “Scrape URL” needs a web address as input, so pass one from the earlier step.
